title: Mutual Freeze Between Billing and Notification Services
description: Billing-service and notification-service have stopped processing requests. CPU and memory are completely flat, but all requests hang indefinitely.

ground_truth.root_cause_summary: Distributed circular lock deadlock: billing-service holds Lock A (invoice) and synchronously waits for notification-service, while notification-service holds Lock B (customer) and synchronously waits for billing-service.
key_evidence: Topology shows circular synchronous HTTP dependency between billing-service and notification-service
Logs show billing waiting for notification ACK while notification waits for billing customer verification
Deployments show recent change converted notification dispatch from asynchronous queue to synchronous HTTP call
distractors: Metrics show 0% errors (requests don't fail, they just hang forever)

logs.message: Thread pool saturation: 100% of threads in BLOCKED state waiting for downstream lock release

billing-service.author: sync_dev@orange.com
billing-service.commit_message: Switch notification dispatch from RabbitMQ to direct synchronous HTTP client
